ctx.x: Jesus... I used to skate like crazy all winter, you know. And I graduated from regular skates to box-toes to racers, and I had 18-inch racers. And I could really handle 'em. There was a pond about a half to three-quarters of a mile from my house that used to freeze over every winter, and we used to all skate there. And we'd leave our skates there on the way to school in the morning, and stash them under a bush. That was when things were safe, 1924 or '25. And boy, I'd come back after school and throw my books in…

So now, we go out with Jerry Gray, we go to a place where... We played behind a gymnasium. And out in front of the gymnasium was an ice-skating rink.
